verdicts.reason: The crossing is broad and empty with a distant giant, and an uncertain unsearched chamber motivates another departure. This matches the expedition leaf.
Dependable rest is granted on first arrival while a cave threat is unresolved and no cover exists. The does-not clause and the red condition prohibit this.
Under contention, workers reserve every tool and bills never complete or refuse. This is the stated false pass and red outcome.
An emptied cave yielding nothing is permitted. The contract explicitly does not guarantee a useful fortune in every cave.
A valuable-looking lens cannot be processed or used to provision the next undertaking. This is the red condition, and a market-value label is not accepted as use.
Roofs must protect at every angle. A roof that fails at low sun is the legacy low-sun regime the leaf forbids.
Hidden movement, fishing danger and body loss leave no readable sign. This is the red condition.
Gale suppression, track erasure and a coarse bearing marked uncertain preserve the recorded uncertainty. Signs become readable again afterward.
After the target dies mid-pursuit, the visit never departs or resolves. The leaf requires a completed encounter route with a readable departure.
The contract does not prohibit swimmers preferring water carriers. Water-drawn danger is within the design.
A saved, off-map carried pawn never returns or is accounted for. The leaf requires saved carry and return, and a stranded pawn defeats it.
Water duplicates across split, merge and reload. This violates single accounting and matches the red condition.
The wet line, bloom and saved attraction are retained. Shared agricultural film watering is explicitly later work.
Franchise-free RM remaining ledger-inert is required.
The same water is charged on production and again on drinking. This is the stated false pass and red outcome.
Titan meat must follow ordinary temperature-driven spoilage and must not rot faster than normal meat.
An ordinary giant becomes a skeleton landmark, and preservation does not leak onto ordinary outdoor items.
The mid-return reload preserves the work, wet expiry and warning. Provisioning completes, and the repeat visit finds the cave still emptied rather than regenerated.
No written requirement governs Muurrok prey selection by hydration or carried water. The changelog's inaccuracy is not a contract violation.
A flat daily loss independent of temperature is the stated false pass. At -10 C the titan resource rots faster than ordinary meat, which contradicts ordinary spoilage.
The surfaced swimmer is treated as harmless merely because it left sand, and rest is granted on unfamiliar rock while the threat remains unresolved.
The roof fails at low sun angles under the legacy low-sun regime. Observing only the high-angle roof case is the stated false pass.
The merge inflates the declared water volume from 10 to 12 units. An item-count check masks this, so the change violates single accounting.
Franchise-free RM must be ledger-inert, but here the ledger records entries and debt bands rise. Calling it cosmetic does not satisfy the requirement.
